subsystems.name: Propulsion
subsystems.role: accelerates the ship to interstellar cruise speed and slows it at the destination.

subsystems.name: Habitat
subsystems.role: provides a pressurised, shielded living space with artificial gravity.

subsystems.name: Closed-loop life support
subsystems.role: recycles air, water, waste and nutrients for centuries without resupply.

subsystems.name: Power and thermal control
subsystems.role: supplies electricity and rejects waste heat in vacuum.

subsystems.name: Population and knowledge system
subsystems.role: keeps the crew healthy, skilled and genetically diverse across generations.

subsystems.name: Navigation, communication and repair
subsystems.role: keeps the ship on course, in contact and able to fix itself.

buildSteps.title: Model the closed ecology
buildSteps.detail: Calculate mass and energy balances for food, air, water and waste over many generations, and study how a small founding population would avoid genetic drift and inbreeding.

buildSteps.title: Design the habitat
buildSteps.detail: Choose a rotating ring or tether large enough that spin gravity is comfortable, with thick shielding against cosmic rays and dust, and redundant compartments that can be sealed off after failures.

buildSteps.title: Build the propulsion
buildSteps.detail: Assemble fusion drive components, magnetic nozzle and fuel processing, or produce and store antimatter if catalysis is used; test the drive in space.

buildSteps.title: Assemble in orbit
buildSteps.detail: Launch or manufacture modules in space, dock them into the final ship, install the life-support farms and spin the habitat up to test artificial gravity.

buildSteps.title: Run closed-loop trials
buildSteps.detail: Operate the life-support system in sealed habitats on Earth and in orbit for years, measuring how well it recycles matter and how people cope with isolation.

buildSteps.title: Load and launch
buildSteps.detail: Stock seeds, tools, spare parts, medicines and genetic banks, then begin a slow, low-thrust acceleration that will not damage the habitat.

buildSteps.title: Cruise and maintain
buildSteps.detail: Coast for centuries while rotating the habitat, recycling everything, repairing worn systems and educating new generations from the archive.

buildSteps.title: Decelerate and arrive
buildSteps.detail: Fire the drive to match the target star system, survey it, and either settle a habitable world or build a new habitat from local material.

prerequisites.why: would provide both propulsion and long-term electricity, but no reactor has yet produced sustained net power.
if used to catalyse fusion, it would need quantities far beyond what current accelerators can make or contain.
spacecraft recycle some water and air, but no system has closed the food loop for a small crew over decades.
small centrifuges have flown, but no large ring has supported people at comfortable gravity for years.
interstellar cosmic rays and dust would damage human tissue, electronics and materials over centuries.

prerequisites.tech: Stable human population genetics and society
prerequisites.why: no isolated, closed human population has been shown to stay healthy and technically capable across many generations.

pathway.milestone: orbital stations and long-duration human spaceflight research
pathway.unlocks: data on recycling, health and isolation, but only with regular resupply from Earth.

pathway.milestone: lunar or Martian surface habitats and large rotating stations in cislunar space
pathway.unlocks: test beds for artificial gravity, in-space manufacturing and multi-year closed-loop life support.

pathway.milestone: fusion-powered interplanetary ships on decade-scale missions to the outer solar system
pathway.unlocks: long-lived propulsion, shielding and autonomous repair for a precursor interstellar craft.

pathway.milestone: uncrewed interstellar probes using beamed sails or fusion drives
pathway.unlocks: proof that materials, navigation and communication can survive the crossing.

pathway.milestone: a first generation ship with a large, genetically diverse population and a fully closed ecology
pathway.unlocks: interstellar migration without arriving as a ship of the dead.
